g.text: Weights unpacked by digest (hash equals original)
cmd: just kit-supply-check | pass: prints 'unpack-by-digest: rc=0 weights_sha256=<hash>' equal to the original's hash
cmd: just kit-supply-check | pass: prints 'wrong-digest: rc=<non-zero> unpacked=False' and 'pinned-after-tamper: rc=0' with the original hash
cmd: just kit-supply-check | pass: prints 'PASS kit-supply' and podman ps -a lists no wattson-kit-registry
